headlines.text: 2024 brought us this moment: Bryan Danielson vs. Adam Page met in an Owen Hart Tournament Final, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 8.80 ? a war that left everything in the ring.
It was 2025 when RPG Vice & Fletcher kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.47.
Rewind to 2024, when Mariah May vs. Willow Nightingale met in an Owen Hart Tournament Final, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 6.96.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when Christian Cage reached a solid half-century of matches: their 50th match in AEW, facing The Outrunners vs. JetSpeed vs. FTR vs. The Patriarchy (Tag) vs. Truth Magnum vs. Turbo Floyd vs. Kevin Knight vs. Mike Bailey vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. Christian Cage vs. Nick Wayne on Collision, rated 7.48 ? a solid showing.
2025 brought us this moment: Mina Shirakawa vs. Queen Aminata vs. Thunder Rosa vs. Willow Nightingale vs. Athena vs. Julia Hart vs. Thekla vs. Megan Bayne closed out Collision, rated 6.86.
It was 2025 when Gabe Kidd returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Collision.
